name: Moz
summary: Moz Links API: Domain Authority, Page Authority, backlinks, anchor text, linking domains and top pages.

token.description: a Moz API token (Moz API dashboard at moz.com/api/dashboard, + Add Token)

notes: Every call is a POST with a JSON body to https://lsapi.seomoz.com/v2/<endpoint>, including reads.
Usage is counted in rows, not requests. Free access allows one request every ten seconds and 50 rows a month; paid plans bill overage. Some endpoints are weighted (see each note).
Lists paginate with limit (1-50, default 25) and next_token.

Written from Moz's Links API V2 help pages, which Moz labels legacy now that all Moz API endpoints are in one unified API; the Links V2 pages remain published, and the token is the documented credential for them. Older accounts can use HTTP Basic (Access ID and Secret Key) instead; this entry uses the token.

endpoints.name: URL metrics
endpoints.summary: Domain Authority, Page Authority, Spam Score, link counts and more for up to 50 URLs.

targets.description: Up to 50 URLs, subdomains or root domains.

daily_history_deltas.description: Metrics to return daily history for, as dated gains and losses.

daily_history_values.description: Metrics to return daily history for, as date and value pairs.

monthly_history_deltas.description: Metrics to return 32 months of history for, as gains and losses.

monthly_history_values.description: Metrics to return 32 months of history for, as date and value pairs.

notes: A read over POST: Moz Links V2 takes every call as POST with a JSON body, and nothing is changed.
Weighted: one row per call with no options; each history metric requested and distributions=true each add one row to usage.
You cannot pick metrics; all are returned for each target.

endpoints.name: Links to a target
endpoints.summary: Individual links pointing at a page, subdomain or root domain, with anchor text and first and last seen dates.

target.description: The URL to get links for.

target_scope.description: Scope of the target. Default page.

sort.description: Sort order, descending. Default source_page_authority; see the docs page for the valid values per scope.

anchor_text.description: Only links whose normalized anchor text matches.

source_root_domain.description: Only links from this source root domain.

source_scope.description: With subdomain or root_domain, return only the best link from each source at that scope. Default page.

next_token.description: next_token from a previous answer; send it to get the next page.

notes: A read over POST: Moz Links V2 takes every call as POST with a JSON body, and nothing is changed.
One row of usage per link returned. Paginate with next_token.

endpoints.name: Anchor text to a target
endpoints.summary: Anchor texts used in links to a target, with referring root domain and page counts.

target.description: The target to get anchor text for.

scope.description: Scope of links to the target. Default page.

next_token.description: next_token from a previous answer; send it to get the next page.

notes: A read over POST: Moz Links V2 takes every call as POST with a JSON body, and nothing is changed.

endpoints.name: Linking root domains
endpoints.summary: Root domains that link to a target, with their Domain Authority, spam score and link counts.

target.description: A URL to get linking root domains for.

target_scope.description: Scope of the target. Default page.

sort.description: Sort order, descending. Default source_domain_authority; date_gained and date_lost sort newest first.

filter.description: Filter expression such as external or external+follow. Default external.

begin_date.description: With sort date_gained or date_lost: earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: With sort date_gained or date_lost: latest date, YYYY-MM-DD.

next_token.description: next_token from a previous answer; send it to get the next page.

notes: A read over POST: Moz Links V2 takes every call as POST with a JSON body, and nothing is changed.

endpoints.name: Top pages on a domain
endpoints.summary: A domain's strongest pages by Page Authority, with their metrics.

target.description: The domain to return top pages for.

scope.description: Scope of the target. Default root_domain.

filter.description: Only pages whose last crawl returned this status. Default all.

next_token.description: next_token from a previous answer; send it to get the next page.

notes: A read over POST: Moz Links V2 takes every call as POST with a JSON body, and nothing is changed.

endpoints.name: Link intersect
endpoints.summary: Sources that link to some targets but not others, for finding link-building opportunities.

positive_targets.description: Targets whose linkers you want, as {target, scope} objects. Together with negative_targets, up to 6 targets.

negative_targets.description: Targets whose linkers to exclude, as {target, scope} objects.

min_matching_targets.description: Only sources that link to at least this many positive targets.

source_scope.description: Scope of sources returned. Default page.

next_token.description: next_token from a previous answer; send it to get the next page.

notes: A read over POST: Moz Links V2 takes every call as POST with a JSON body, and nothing is changed.
Weighted: each returned row counts as 5 rows of usage (a limit of 50 can use 250).

endpoints.name: Link status
endpoints.summary: Whether each of up to 50 sources links to a target.

target.description: The target to check links to.

target_scope.description: Scope of the target. Default page.

source_scope.description: Scope of each source. Default page.

notes: A read over POST: Moz Links V2 takes every call as POST with a JSON body, and nothing is changed.
Weighted: each source counts as 2 rows of usage.

endpoints.name: Index metadata
endpoints.summary: Information about the current Links index. Send an empty body.
notes: A read over POST: Moz Links V2 takes every call as POST with a JSON body, and nothing is changed.

endpoints.name: Usage data
endpoints.summary: Rows consumed in a time period (default: the current month).

start.description: Period start as Unix seconds, passed as a string. Default: start of this month.

end.description: Period end as Unix seconds, passed as a string. Default: now.

notes: A read over POST: Moz Links V2 takes every call as POST with a JSON body, and nothing is changed.
